events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Chill in the Palace

options.text: He has fallen victim to his own treachery.
Provide him with the best treatment available.

events.text: After returning from a "private" trip to the country, your spouse, [character], has succumbed to a terrible fever. Even more troubling are the rumors of infidelity. He spends so much time away that the gossip is unavoidable. Royal healers seek counsel on how to treat the situation.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Chilly Reception

options.text: I will devote my time to lavishing [character] with affection.
Keep him entertained with various tutors and amusements.
[nation] will not waste energy on political games.

events.text: Visiting the family home of your husband, [character], you receive a chilly reception. Stories of your indifference towards him are not new, and despite your role as the powerful ruler of [nation], you are still responsible for the [family]'s beloved [character]. If anything, this visit has been an omen of things to come. The [family] are powerful and it would be unwise to further chasten them. [character] has more sway than you realize.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: A Classic Tragedy

options.text: The final wishes of my husband shall be respected.
[character] shall be cursed for defiling [character].
We must investigate this matter before acting.

events.text: A troubling report arrives concerning [character]. [character] has been found dead, with a letter condemning [character] of forcing himself upon him. Out of shame, and at the behest of the goddess of love, the letter requests that you sentence [character] to death for this unspeakable crime. [character] protests his innocence in this most serious matter.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Family Affair

options.text: Throw them in prison for their betrayal.
I will release [character] from his obligation.
Let us wait and see where this goes.

events.text: It gives us no pleasure to bring you some shocking news. Your husband, [character], has been hiding a romantic tryst with your brother [character]. It has been going on for several years, and neither had any intention of telling you. Your closest advisors wish to assist in this matter, and we await your command.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: A Gift

options.text: Such a delightful gift!
I'll add them to my collection.

events.text: Unexpectedly, [character] has arrived with a thoughtful gift! You have no idea how he knew, but he got you exactly what you most wanted, a set of carved miniature soldiers with which to fight mock battles with!

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: A Matter of Concern

options.text: A pet fish might cheer [character] up.
I will fund an independent expedition and name some new marvel of the land after him!
I do worry about [character], but I also have a nation to run.

events.text: You lie awake, the evening stretching out into the darkness of night. As your mind laboriously cycles through each of the day’s events, from a court meeting about frontier exploration to remnants of regret over one too many servings at dinner, at last you find yourself thinking of [character], who hasn’t been himself lately. The slouch in his shoulders and despondency in his voice remind you that [character]’s life has been difficult at times. Maybe there is something you can do to lift his spirits.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: A New General

options.text: [character] is worthy. Appoint him as the General of a [unit].
Agreed, but let him lead a ranged unit. How about this [unit]?
Don't you think it's a little early to plan my death?

events.text: [character] comes to you, declaring that as [character] is now an adult, he should lead one of your armies, paving the way to the throne after you are gone.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Question of Succession

options.text: No, [character] will be the better ruler.
[character] will now be next in line.

events.text: In a moment of anxiety, your husband confides in you. After such a tragic loss, he worries that your son [character], his favorite, may be next. He pleads with you to change the succession so your other child, [character] becomes the heir.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: A Scoundrel

options.text: Exile [character] before it gets worse.

requirements.label: Not Debauched / Not Wanton
tip: The leader must have one of: Not Debauched; Not Wanton

options.text: Spend more time with him to blunt his worst impulses.

events.text: Stories in the palace paint a scandalous picture of your son [character]. We dare not speak aloud the charges leveled against him, but they are the kind that can forever stain a ruler's legacy. What shall we do?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Spark

options.text: Let us see where this goes.
This has been nice, but it must end now.

events.text: One evening, as courtly revels end, you meet a fascinating young envoy from faraway named [character]. Her beauty catches your eye, and her laughter lightens your heart. As the sun rises, [character] asks if she may meet you again, when she returns to [city]. Setting her cool gaze upon you, she waits for an answer...

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Affairs of the Heart

options.text: Stay out of my personal affairs... or else.
I will renew my focus on our nation.
You forget your place, [character]!

events.text: After years of marriage, you are approached privately by [character]. "You are too often distracted by affairs of the heart." he explains. "Are there not more pressing concerns facing our nation?" Is this bitterness a result of true concern, or is he simply jealous? How will you respond?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Alien Traditions

options.text: Share your unease at the questions that your spouse has raised.
Encourage [character] to try to blend in.
Defend [character] curiosity and drive to improve the court.

events.text: Not raised in the court of [rival], [character] often raises questions about the way that things are done in your court, from meals to religious ceremonies. The traditional [character] and the [family] have taken offense at some of your spouse's recent questions about the origins of the rules around family land-owning, claiming that he is an interloper and aiming to usurp the traditions of [rival].

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Amity or Treason?

options.text: Perhaps my time on the throne is at an end.
What is good for me is good for this nation.
The price for this treasonous request? Your head.

events.text: In private, your wife, [character], confesses to worrying about your state of mind, citing examples of your selfishness and vanity. She explains that others in the court have similar concerns. "Sometimes, the good of the nation outweighs the good of its ruler." She suggests that you abdicate, clearing the way for a young heir.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Asherah

options.text: Commission statues of Asherah.
Mark a new holy day to celebrate Asherah.
Refuse to aid [character] or his god.

events.text: Your spouse [character] has been talking to the Kohanim about the state of [religion] in [rival]. He wants to revive the worship of Asherah, the queen consort of the [religion] God and a goddess of motherhood and fertility. This move to encourage the worship of God’s consort is no doubt to strengthen [character]’s own position of power, but bringing Asherah back to the fore could also help to spread [religion].

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Barren

options.text: Offer a sacrifice to the gods, and seek their blessings.
Take a fertile servant to bear you children.

events.text: Since you and your spouse [character] have borne no children to be your heirs, you seek the counsel of your courtiers, wise men, and religious leaders. Your line must continue!

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Best Served Cold

options.text: Send him to a temple for a divine cure.
Imprison him in the city jail.
Execute him for the murder of [character].

events.text: One morning, your breakfast tray includes the decapitated head of your lover, [character]. After a speedy investigation, we have captured [character], whose obsession and jealousy led him to such a gristly act. Now we must decide what to do with him.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Bullying Heir

options.text: Ignore it. Dominance is the natural order.

events.text: Your heir, [character], has been caught bullying his brother [character]. Such repeated torment appears to be taking a toll. How will you handle this family strife?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Cause for Worry

options.text: I do not pay heed to unworthy gossip.
We must investigate these rumors.

events.text: Lately, your husband, [character], has been seen around the city with another member of the court. Rumors of a love affair are spreading like wild fire. What shall we do?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Change of Heart

options.text: That gold must be used for other endeavors.
I will speak to [character] about frugality.
Commit to spending more time together in a bid to keep him from spending so lavishly.

events.text: Another night of revels has come and gone, leaving the court with debts to pay. The King, [character], fills every evening with feasting, musicians, and wine from the country. We cannot sustain such expenses.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
conditions: Not Any Descendant Of Leader Us
events.name: Childhood Fight

options.text: [character] must learn fear. Torture [character].
[character] must be punished for fighting my family.
[character] must learn to finish his own fights.

events.text: [character] comes before you in a panic. Your advisors explain that your child [character] picked a fight with [character]’s child [character] and was soundly beaten. [character] is horrified that his child laid hands on a member of your family and begs for your forgiveness in the matter.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Combat Training

options.text: Hire a veteran soldier as a tutor.
It is too expensive.
The nation's budget won't support such an expense, but I shall take it upon myself to instruct him.

events.text: Your husband has shown promise in basic weapons drills. Shall we secure the services of a professional soldier to further [character]'s combat training?

events.author: Solver
events.name: Coming of Age

options.text: [character] should study the Torah to understand the responsibilities he will face.
This is a joyous occasion! The people of [city] are invited to celebrate.
Ask [character] to honor our family by reading from the siddur at the ceremony.
I will lead the prayers myself on this joyous occasion.

events.text: It seems like yesterday that [character] was a baby, but time has flown and he is almost a grown man now. As is [religion] custom, a bar mitzvah ceremony should be held for [character]. There's no doubt that [character] will make you proud with his. How can we best make the bar mitzvah further our needs?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Creative Pursuits

options.text: Hire a skilled artist.
It is too expensive.
While we lack sufficient resources for that, promise that you'll spend time on creative endeavors together in the year ahead.

events.text: Your husband, [character], wishes to indulge his creative tendencies and decorate the palace with works of art. Shall we accommodate him?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Daughter of the Storm Temple

options.text: NO! I think I'll just try to walk it off, thanks.

outcomes.label: Daughter Of The Storm Temple Help Me Doomed
Daughter Of The Storm Temple Help Me Not Doomed
Daughter Of The Storm Temple Tithe Doomed
Daughter Of The Storm Temple Tithe Not Doomed

events.text: Rumors of your severe illness have spread, and in response, the Priestess of a minor temple in [city] has sent one of their own, a Daughter of the Storm Temple to your court to render assistance. Do you allow her entrance into your bed chamber to tend to your illness?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Deeper Meaning

options.text: Hire a master philosopher.
It is too expensive.
Although we lack the funds to hire a true master, I shall do my best to instruct him myself.

events.text: Palace servants often find [character] walking among the gardens, openly pondering questions of life, mortality, and desire. One day, he asks if he may take lessons with one of the court philosophers. How shall we accommodate?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Distracting Child

options.text: Hiking in the snowy mountains.

tip: As leader: +10% Height From Modifier / Hill
As general: +25% Height From Modifier / Hill

options.text: Exploring the hills and cliffs.
Tracking animals in the woods.

events.text: Your energetic son [character] is distracting you from your royal duties, and something must done. What activities do you suggest?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Do it Yourself

options.text: Maybe this was a foolish idea.
Patient, heal thyself.
Thankfully, I know what I am doing.

events.text: You have suffered enough in the grasp of this terrible illness. The time has come to take matters into your own hands. Gathering a collection of herbs, minerals, and ritual substances, you and [character] prepare to remedy whatever malicious ailment has possessed you. You prepare for the bloodletting....

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Doctor Pieface

options.text: Argh! Remove yourself immediately!
I choose to gamble with my life.

events.text: You are awakened from your feverish slumber by the ridiculous visage of [character]. He staggers drunkenly into your chambers, carrying a handful of some mysterious substance and a rusty blade. "I have come to heal you, my [title]!" You have a sneaking suspicion that the mysterious substance is bird droppings.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Domestic Dispute

options.text: Remove [character] from the court immediately.
Nonsense! Buy [character] a pet monkey for amusement.
Not a bad idea. Take [character] as a lover.

events.text: Over the past few evenings, you have been glimpsed walking in the gardens with [character] of the court. Word has reached your husband, and he expresses irritation at this familiarity. He demands that you remove such distractions, or he threatens to make your life on the throne much harder.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Downward Spiral

options.text: I will step away to comfort my grieving husband.
I will remain in the capital and attend court.

events.text: Your grieving husband will not emerge from his chambers, and the servants grow worried. Something must be done to bring him back from the edge of despair. Unfortunately, pressing matters call for attention in [city], and a crowd of supplicants waits to be seen.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Drawn From the Rock

options.text: They are right, this is a sign.
It is just a relic from a long gone age.
What a curious sword! I must have it for myself.

events.text: Your children [character] and [character] have taken to playing in the lands around the capital, carefully watched by royal guards. A large rock looms nearby to their favorite spot, a single cleft wending its way up the otherwise unmarked face of stone. You later hear that [character] reached his arm into this crack, spurred on by a dare from [character]. On pulling it out, his small hand grasped an ancient blade, marked with an engraving in an old form of [rival] writing. It claims that the blade is the sword of kings. Rumors are already spreading that it is a sign that [character] has been chosen to rule. What will you do with this mysterious blade?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Dreams of the Dead

options.text: I vow to be better!
The dead should not bother the living.

events.text: You awaken, rather disturbed, from a vivid dream of your dead father. He was berating your failure to emulate his virtues.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Dwindling Line

options.text: I will adopt [character].
I will adopt [character].
I will adopt [character].
I refuse to sully my line with non-royal blood.

events.text: The royal line withers... and you are growing older. It is time to introduce some fresh blood into the dynasty to ensure its survival. The noble families all contain promising candidates who would be glad to join your household, if you so choose.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Eloped!

options.text: Let the lovers find a joyful destiny together.
Send soldiers to bring them back at once!
Claim the wedding was planned, to save face.

events.text: By the time you hear the news, the young couple has already fled the city. Overwhelmed with passion, your son [character] has eloped with his beloved. The two have a significant head start... that is if you plan to pursue them.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Empty Bed

options.text: Yes, I require companionship.
I will not defile my marriage bed.

events.text: Your husband, [character], has been away from the palace for many nights, and the royal bed grows cold. Perhaps you should request the company of one of your servants... to keep you warm.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Enchanting Conversation

options.text: Let us see where the night takes us.
A ruler needs his rest.

events.text: During a royal feast, you share an enchanting conversation with one of your minor courtiers. The wine flows freely, as the two of you talk late into the night. The revelry comes to a close, but your companion lingers on as the rest of the guests depart...

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Enchanting Conversation

options.text: I'm looking forward to it!
A ruler needs his rest.

events.text: During a royal feast, you share an enchanting conversation with one of your minor courtiers. She is tall and strong, and behaves in a most unladylike manner, which you find indescribably alluring. You inquire about her interests and find she is a talented stonemason and has exceptionally strong hands. She accepts your offer to show off the stonework around your palace after the feast concludes.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Enchanting Conversation

options.text: I'm looking forward to it!
A ruler needs his rest.

events.text: During a royal feast, you share an enchanting conversation with one of your minor courtiers. Tall and well-muscled, he shares your passion for wrestling and reveals that he was undefeated in his hometown. Intrigued, you offer to show him how it’s done in [city] and challenge him to a friendly bout. He agrees to meet you after the feast concludes.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Enchanting Conversation

options.text: I'm looking forward to it!
A ruler needs his rest.

events.text: During a royal feast, you share an enchanting conversation with one of your minor courtiers. She is quite beautiful, and as it turns out, you have several favourite poets in common. A passionate discussion ensues, aided by the free-flowing wine. She accepts your offer to meet in a quieter location after the feast concludes to continue your conversation.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Enchanting Conversation

options.text: I'm looking forward to it!
A ruler needs his rest.

events.text: During a royal feast, you share an enchanting conversation with one of your minor courtiers. He is an exceptionally pretty man and is dressed in the latest fashion. You have an enthralling conversation about fashions and the use of fabrics, and you offer to let him try on a few of your outfits which you think would look much better on him. He agrees to meet you after the feast concludes.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Family Adoption

options.text: Yes, [character] will be my heir.
No, another heir must be found.

events.text: While you have no valid heirs, a potential candidate within your own family has come to light. Do you wish to adopt [character]?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Fatal Attraction

options.text: I'm the life of the court! Or, the death, I guess... Who doesn't like a bit of drama?
Perhaps we should behave with more modesty and stop flirting.
We shall hold a state funeral for the deceased.

events.text: You find yourself in an impossible situation. [character] and [character] have both sworn their undying love for you, and have been showering you with flattery and gifts. Their mutual envy has poisoned many a court meeting, and at times has almost come to blows. Shockingly, but predictably, the two fools murder each other in a bathhouse duel over your affections. Their bodies are found wrapped in a deadly embrace, splattered with blood and soap, daggers still held in clenched fists. It seems you might be too well liked...

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Favored Spouse

options.text: [character], of course!
[character] is my favorite.
Please stop, I value you both equally.

events.text: [character] and [character] are squabbling about which of them is your favorite. As neither of them want to concede to the other, they demand that you settle matters once and for all!

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: God's Consort

options.text: Grant the title of God’s Consort.

tip: As leader: +5% State Religion Spread Chance

options.text: There is no need for such earthly titles.

events.text: As a living god, you notice your earthly husband in a sullen state of late. On questioning, he feels that as the partner to a living god he should be given a suitable title.

events.author: Solver
events.name: Golden Gifts

options.text: I will wear these jewels proudly.
Keep the finest pieces, but give some to noble families.
Hand it out among the people of [city].

events.text: Your husband [character] surprises you with a beautiful gift, bringing an assortment of fine jewelry crafted in [city] from the city's own Gold. "My love for you shines brighter than this gold," he says, "and I know you will, in your wisdom, use it well."

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Gowns of Silk

options.text: We cannot afford such luxuries.
Give [character] what he wants.

events.text: Your brother's servant comes with a request: [character] wishes to procure gold from the treasury to purchase silk for new fineries. He insists that is required for the dignity of his royal position.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Harsh Words

options.text: I will look to your soldiers for inspiration.
One so heartless should not be a leader.
You are correct, and it is time to show strength.

events.text: The court moves forward with business, even as a pall of death hangs over the palace. The popular general [character] has come to express his deepest regrets. However, he is also critical of your support of the military. "I mean no disrespect, but it seems your loss has left you fearful of bloodshed."

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Heir Crisis

options.text: Arrange for my wife to have an "accident."
I must divorce [character].
If the gods will it...
The gods have always looked after me, and behold, they have blessed us again!

events.text: There is a growing concern among members of the court. You have no viable heirs, and your wife, [character], is beyond child-bearing age. You must consider your legacy. The fate of our nation is at stake...

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Heir of Corruption

options.text: He will be punished accordingly.
Boys will have their fun.
There are no excuses for waste!

events.text: It has come to your attention that your heir, [character], has been secretly instructing judges and ministers to pocket public funds for their own coffers. This is the same [character] who recently moved his private residence to a plundered holy site, angering many of your more superstitious subjects. Something must be done!

events.author: Solver
events.name: Heretic Spouse

options.text: Publicly rebuke [character] in support of [religion].
Arrange some time alone with [character] to mend the relationship.

events.text: Your strained relationship with your husband, [character], has mostly been out of the public eye. But recently, he made several public statements in support of [religion], with thinly veiled criticism of our official faith, [religion]. There's no reason to believe [character] cares one bit for [religion]. His actions are clearly meant to provoke you.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Holy Matrimony

options.text: We will hire staff to aid in your royal duties.

tip: As leader: +5% State Religion Spread Chance

options.text: You should devote yourself to [religion].

tip: As leader: +50 Unit Trait XP / Infantry
As governor: +100 Unit Trait XP / Infantry

options.text: They are right, your duty is to [rival].

events.text: Your husband, [character], has been throwing himself into his duties as the head of [religion]. Everyday he is meeting with the and organizing the movements of the faith. [character] comes to you asking for help. The [family] family are complaining that he has been slacking in his royal duties, but he is determined not to relinquish the role of religious leader.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Horseback Riding

tip: As leader: +50 Unit Trait XP / Mounted
As governor: +100 Unit Trait XP / Mounted

options.text: Hire a riding master.
It is too expensive.
Although the budget won’t support such an action just now, promise to spend more time with your beloved.

events.text: For months, your husband has expressed an interest in mastering horseback riding. Shall we accommodate him?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
conditions: Not In Love With Leader Hidden
events.name: Indifferent Queen

options.text: We do enjoy each other's company.
I will not forsake my marriage vows.

events.text: Your wife, the queen consort, spends more and more nights at her private estate outside the capital. When she visits the palace, she treats you with cold indifference. Meanwhile, your beautiful, lowborn hunting companion has drawn your attention. Shall we arrange some private time for you?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Jealous Rage

options.text: Imprison the plotters, but free my husband.
Time in a cold cell will cool his passions.
How can I part with such a devoted spouse?

events.text: We have terrible news. In a jealous rage, your husband has been caught plotting the murder of [character], who he believed was courting your affections. What is your judgement on the king's fate?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
conditions: Not Any Descendant Of Leader Us
events.name: Late Nights

options.text: Stop this foolishness now.
You should have just asked me. Visit him whenever you want.

events.text: On the first night, the palace guards hear the sound of someone climbing the walls. When they go to investigate, nothing is found. On the second night, scuff marks can be seen around the base of the walls. On the third night, the culprit is caught. Avoiding your gaze, [character] is brought before you. Reluctantly, he admits that he has been sneaking out to visit [character].

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Legal Instruction

options.text: Hire a former judge as a tutor.
It is too expensive.
While the nation's budget won't support hiring a retired judge, offer to take the time to instruct your beloved personally.

events.text: In the last few years, your husband [character] has demonstrated a natural aptitude for public speaking. He now requests training in the art of law. Shall we grant this request?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Legitimize Heir

options.text: We must legitimize [character].
I will not allow it.

events.text: The court grows concerned over your lack of heirs. How will the dynasty continue? They suggest that one option would be to legitimize [character].

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Legitimize Heir

options.text: We must legitimize [character].
I will not allow it.

events.text: The court grows concerned over your lack of heirs. How will the dynasty continue? They suggest that one option would be to legitimize [character].

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Legitimize Heir

options.text: We must legitimize [character].
I will not allow it.

events.text: The court grows concerned over your lack of heirs. How will the dynasty continue? They suggest that one option would be to legitimize [character].

events.author: Josh Unsworth
conditions: Not Any Descendant Of Leader Us
events.name: Little Leader

options.text: It’s his natural charm!
He will keep [character] in line.
Praise [character] in front of the court.

events.text: Wherever [character] goes, [character] follows. [character]’s influence is strong, and draws comments about how he has the makings of a great leader. Will you encourage this praise?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Lover No More

options.text: Order [character] to assassinate the [title].
Instead, order [character] to assassinate [character].
I will not embrace reckless murder.

events.text: After another passionate meeting, your lover, [character], reveals his growing discontent with the affair. "I will not settle for secrecy any longer. I wish to be king." He suggests an assassination plot to murder your husband, which would take time and planning. Not to mention a cold heart. Our spymaster, [character], awaits your orders...

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Miraculous Recovery

options.text: Thank [character] for intervening.
Chide [character] for not asking first.

events.text: [character] is close to death, and nothing that the, doctors or elders have done is able to stop it. All seems lost when [character] appears, sealing himself in the room with [character] for a day and refusing to let anyone in. Just as the decision is made to send guards in to stop whatever malpractice is being committed [character] walks out looking as healthy as he has ever been. [character] follows, with naught but a wry smile.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Miraculous Recovery

options.text: Thank [character] for intervening.
Chide [character] for not asking first.

events.text: [character] is close to death, and nothing that the, doctors or elders have done is able to stop it. All seems lost when [character] appears, sealing himself in the room with [character] for a day and refusing to let anyone in. Just as the decision is made to send guards in to stop whatever malpractice is being committed [character] walks out looking as healthy as he has ever been. [character] follows, with naught but a wry smile.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Monastic Living

options.text: Send him and make the donation.
Let him go, but refuse to donate.

events.text: Your husband wishes to spend a year among the monks in [city] to master his passions. The monks are honored, but they request a donation to keep the monastery in good repair for their royal guest. Shall we grant their request?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Mountain Lights

options.text: I believe Zoroaster has much to teach us.
Religion is personal, not political.

events.text: Your husband, [character], requests your presence at a private gathering organized by friends. In a Zoroastrianism ceremony atop a hill, groups of recent immigrants pray to an almighty presence. They face the warmth of a roaring flame. The experience touches you, but what does it all mean?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Mysterious Infant

options.text: We will raise him as our own.
He will stay but never be our blood.
Return the child to where it was found.

events.text: One night, as your husband strolls the gardens, he discovers a small bundle resting beneath a tree. It is an infant, small and sickly. He brings the child to you, believing this meeting was orchestrated by the gods.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Opportunists

options.text: Tell the people of [city] that I stand with them.
You will not hold me nor my subjects hostage.
[rival] deserves better... and so do the [family].

events.text: Your recent loss has emboldened the [family] family, which has been waiting for the right time to assert its influence. [character] visits court, demanding support for his city. He claims you are distracted by grief, and that his people's welfare has been ignored. How will you respond to [character]'s demands?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Outdoor Pastime

options.text: Fishing will teach patience.
Planting will teach concentration.
Tending animals will teach compassion.

events.text: Your son [character] enjoys nature and feels at home in the outdoors. What hobby shall we encourage him to pursue?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Persuasion

options.text: Hire a master orator.
It is too expensive.
Explain that it isn't possible just now, but make a vow to spend more time with him in the year ahead.

events.text: [character] wishes to learn the fine art of courtly persuasion, but he abhors crowded feasts and revels. Shall we accommodate him?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
conditions: Not Any Descendant Of Leader Us
events.name: Playing Ball

options.text: Encourage them to have fun and play.
Encourage them to think about the strategy of the game.
Tell them to stop wasting their time with games.

events.text: The early morning sun streams into the palace, warming the mosaic floors. A faint echo of children's laughter emanates in to your study from the courtyard. Curious, you step outside to find [character] and [character] throwing a pig’s bladder ball to each other. Seeing you pass, the children come over to greet you.

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Pleasing the In-Laws

options.text: Let us give gifts to my in-laws, the [family].
I have no special need to please my in-laws.

events.text: Your in-laws, the [family], feel somewhat neglected, despite their special status as the family of your spouse, [character]. Chancellor [character] believes that we ought to reach out to the [family] through a Family Gift mission. Shall we follow the advice of [character] and send a gift to the [family]?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
conditions: Not In Love With Leader Hidden
events.name: Potential Heir

options.text: Yes, my legacy must be secured.
No, this one will not do.

events.text: As the days pass, you start to worry that there is no one to inherit the realm. After sharing your concern with advisors, they have found an eligible candidate to continue the royal line. Will you adopt [character]?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Reined In

options.text: I must regain my lost authority.
We must uphold the rule of law.

events.text: Privately, your husband expresses his unhappiness with how the court governs. "How can a ruler rule when he is reined in by a constitution? Are you not the [title] of [rival]?" He leaves you alone to think about your power.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Rekindled Passion

options.text: Spend time with your loving husband.
Take a lover on the court.
Visit one of the royal brothels.
Leave me to my sorrow.

events.text: Nothing seems to rouse you from your miserable stupor. Simply rising to meet the morning sun has become a burden. Servants of the royal household grow concerned. They offer several solutions to your current despair, encouraging you to focus on a passionate relationship.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Revenants

options.text: I will busy my thoughts with affairs of state.
I must understand this spectral phenomenon.
Next time, I will be prepared for [character].

events.text: Screams rouse you in the dead of night... You wake to find an apparition at the foot of your bed. When it speaks, it does so in the voice of the departed [character]. Trembling, you turn to light a candle, but when you look again, the phantom has vanished. The next morning, you question this visitation. Was it real, or has the ongoing grief touched your mind?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Role Model

options.text: Provide him with whatever he desires.
By the gods! He needs nothing else!
I have had enough. Give his possessions to the poor.

events.text: Once again, your son [character] comes to you asking for luxuries and indulgences that strain the royal treasury. It occurs to you that he may have learned these habits from your own expensive tastes. Perhaps it is time to teach [character] - and yourself - the true value of money.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Romantic Evening

options.text: There is no time for personal desires.
[character] is important, make it happen.

events.text: A chilly distance seems to separate you from your husband, [character], and it only grows colder. He has asked for time in your busy schedule - to be together, to rekindle the passion. How shall we answer?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Rumor Has It

options.text: People should ignore baseless lies.
He practices an honorable and misunderstood religion.
He must be burned at the stake!

events.text: A rumor that your royal consort is [tribe] warlock has caused an uproar in the streets. Our people will not tolerate a man who allegedly practices barbaric rituals and worships snakes. What shall we do?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Shrine of the Healing God

options.text: Do whatever they ask to get the healing.
Priests be damned, force your way into the spring.
Stick to your doctors and herbs.

events.text: [character] rushes to your side upon hearing of your illness. He conspiratorially whispers that he has heard of a cult in [city], where the attend a sacred spring with healing properties. Upon inquiry the demand a huge sum of money and say that they will use the costs to open their services to all. Will you accept their price?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Signs of Lunacy

options.text: Remove [character]. Children are our future.
This is lunacy! Call the court physicians!

events.text: In a fit of rage, your husband, [character], admits to jealousy over your acquaintance with [character]. He threatens not to bear you any children if you continue to keep such company.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Sponsor a Laboratory

options.text: Open a private laboratory.
It is too expensive.
While there's not enough money in the treasury to support an entire laboratory, promise to spend more time on intellectual pursuits with your husband in the coming year.

events.text: Scientific pursuits seem to intrigue your husband. It may be wise to build a workplace where he could explore the world's many mysteries. Shall we consider it?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Surprise Proposal

options.text: Is this a joke? I am a married man!
Let us be friends and allies... with benefits.
A union would benefit both of us.
I am skilled in balancing multiple lovers.

events.text: Our agents among the [tribe] have been asked to deliver a personal message from [character]. The chief is quite forward in his plea: "You are wise, this is true, but real wisdom comes from knowing when to ally with another. Join me. Wed your power with mine, and we will rule for a thousand years."

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Take Another Husband?

options.text: We will take their gift of gold and accept the proposal.
We will take their military resources and accept the proposal.
A marriage with another family of the court will only divide us.

events.text: The [family] family proposes a marriage between you and [character] to forge a stronger bond. As they understand this may be upsetting to [character], they are offering a gift. If you proceed, your beloved [character] will surely be upset.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Take Another Husband?

options.text: I am more worried about upsetting [character]. However, proceed with the preparations.
Upsetting the people and my husband concerns me too much. I reject the offer.

events.text: The [tribe] have approached the court with a marriage proposal for your royal self. It does not escape the court that such a match will be looked down upon by the people of [rival]. How would you like to respond?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
conditions: Not Any Descendant Of Leader Us
events.name: Teen Idol

options.text: You are born to be a leader, not a follower.
A child should emulate those they admire.

events.text: Your child [character] has taken to following [character] around, excitedly babbling about how he wants to be like [character] when he is older. The court is concerned that [character] may be acquiring a servile character, making him unfit to lead a strong nation. They would like to see this fawning behavior curtailed.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: The Birthday Present

options.text: Let us focus on luxurious delights this year.
We shall hire a tutor for [character]. A warrior of renown.
I can't decide. Let's do both!
These types of fineries are simply beyond our reach at present.

events.text: Your heir, [character], has two loves: fighting and the finest, rarest, most exotic luxuries to be found. This year for his birthday, the thought has occurred to you to give him a gift that caters to one of those two. Only the best for your heir, after all.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Crone

options.text: I will do anything to reclaim my vigor.
Such a cost is unfathomable and cruel.

requirements.label: Charming character / Covert
tip: The leader must have one of: Charming character (a character trait); Covert (a character trait)

options.text: Secretly promise to hand over the child on his eighteenth birthday.

events.text: The misery of ongoing illness motivates you to pursue any potential remedy. Even those considered somewhat... untraditional. A haggard crone appears before the court, having heard news of the king's dire situation. She offers to create a miracle nostrum that will relieve you of your pains. She has but one price: a child of royal blood.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: The Dark Arts

options.text: Against my better judgment, I will allow it.
I don't like to be told what to do.

events.text: [character] is quite impressed with your heir, [character], and would like to have him study the dark arts of espionage.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: The Grove of [character]

options.text: Yes, my dear. That would be lovely!
No, we really don't need it.

events.text: After a long day at court, you repose upon the palace couches with [character], telling him of the day's most notable event. You were walking outside the palace and found the nearby family grove of [character]. After offering to buy the grove, you were rebuffed by a swearing and cursing [character]. "I might have a solution," [character] says, a smile darting across his lips. "I will host a festival. You know how much [character] loves those. I will make an offer he can't refuse." Should we accept his offer?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Mystic

options.text: Yes, you may advise me. Now heal me!
Remove your hands from me, dog!

events.text: One morning, a strange mystic appears on the steps of the court. He meditates with the rising sun and again with the darkening dusk. Later, when you begin coughing blood, the man appears beside you. "This is why I have been summoned," he explains. "I am here to ease your pain." "I can heal you, but you must allow me to sit by your throne and advise you. I have been sent for this purpose."

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Remedy

options.text: Pay whatever is necessary to ease my suffering.
I cannot spend the nation's gold on my survival.

events.text: In the middle of a rigorous debate, you collapse on the floor of the court in a fit of retching and delirium. The court physician is immediately summoned and he attends to your symptoms. Unfortunately, the illness has taken a great toll, and the only way to regain your health is to procure expensive remedies from abroad. What are your orders, our [title]?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Return

options.text: I am ready to leave the past behind us.
Coming to me as I grieve is despicable.

events.text: In the light of recent tragedies, [character] has returned to the palace, seeking reconciliation. He wishes to restore the bond you once shared. The wounds caused by [character] are still raw, but perhaps life is too short to hold grudges.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: The Traveler

options.text: Turn the old man away.
Allow him to stay with the servants.
Give him my private chambers.

events.text: Late one evening, a banging at the palace gate rouses the guards. They discover a hunched old man standing in the driving rain, his feet blistered from weeks of travel. He seeks a night of rest and shelter. Court minister [character] worries that the man may be a foreign agent, or a filthy trickster, but your husband, [character], urges compassion towards the old traveler.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Till the Earth

options.text: Build him a garden outside the palace.
It is too expensive.
An elaborate, private garden is too expensive, but commit to spending time with your husband tending a more modest garden plot.

events.text: Despite his noble position, [character] has always enjoyed gardening and growing food for the royal family. Now he asks for a space of his own to tend. What shall we do?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Time to Feast

options.text: This is no time for banquets!
[character] is not ready for such an honor.
I agree, it is time to celebrate!

events.text: Your spouse, [character], demands that you hold a banquet to celebrate the achievements of your heir, [character], and start paving the way to have him lead your armies one day.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Tribal Training

options.text: Never! The [tribe] cannot be trusted.
It is important to learn from others.

events.text: [character] suggests that your heir [character] might benefit from being exposed to the tribal ways of the [tribe], their culture, language and battle tactics. An extended period of living with them is suggested.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
conditions: Not Any Descendant Of Leader Us
events.name: Two’s Trouble

options.text: These children are out of control!
What evidence is there for accusing [character]?

events.text: [character] and [character] have been inseparable of late. The two children are an irksome presence in the palace, running amok and creating trouble with their pranks and antics. One of your personal scribes comes to you, complaining about their latest mischief. The previous night, the children went into the scribe's hall to take a stylus for writing their own inscriptions, and in doing so managed to break an entire stack of tablets.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
conditions: Not Any Descendant Of Leader Us
events.name: Young Hero

options.text: Thank him for saving [rival] life.
Scold him for jumping into danger - you can't lead if you're dead.
Praise [character] as a hero.

events.text: A group of guards burst into the palace in an uproar. As you move closer, you see that they are carrying two frail looking figures. [character] is drenched and shivering, tightly wrapped in a makeshift bundle of cloths. [character] is similarly bundled, pale and hardly moving. As soon as [character] is in his room and being looked after, you demand an explanation. The guards nervously tell of how they were escorting [character] when they heard a cry for help from the river. Without a thought, [character] leaped in and managed to reach the drowning [character]. The medic comes out and lets you know that [character] is awake.
